structure.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#missing-extensions-after-the-update)更新后缺少扩展？

自 1.10.6 发布版本以来，大多数以前内置的扩展都已转换为可下载的附加组件。您可以通过扩展面板中的内置“下载扩展和资产”菜单（顶部栏中的堆叠块图标）下载它们。

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#branches)分支
structure.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#branches)分支

SillyTavern 正在使用双分支系统进行开发，以确保所有用户都能获得流畅的体验。

- release - 🌟 **建议大多数用户使用。**这是最稳定和最推荐的分支，仅在推送主要版本时更新。它适合大多数用户。

- 分期 - ⚠️ **不建议随意使用。**此分支具有最新功能，但要小心，因为它随时可能中断。仅适用于高级用户和发烧友。

[点击此处](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/branches/)了解详情。

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#features)特征
structure.summary:
The partial document provides an overview of the features of SillyTavern, a versatile and customizable platform for AI-driven interactions. Key highlights include:

1. **Mobile-Friendly Interface**: Ensures usability across various devices.
2. **Multiple Backend API Connections**: Supports integration with numerous AI models and services such as KoboldAI, AI Horde, NovelAI, OpenAI, and more, offering flexibility in AI backend selection.
3. **Visual Novel-like Omniscient Mode**: Provides an immersive storytelling experience.
4. **Stable Diffusion Generation**: Utilizes stable diffusion for generating high-quality content.
5. **TTS Support**: Incorporates text-to-speech capabilities with providers like ElevenLabs and Silero.
6. **WorldInfo (Knowledge Book)**: Allows users to input and utilize detailed world-building information.
7. **Author Notes/Character Bias**: Enables customization of AI behavior and responses.
8. **Customizable UI**: Offers options to personalize colors, backgrounds, avatars, and panel layouts.
9. **AI Response Notification Sounds**: Enhances user experience with auditory cues.
10. **Chat Export**: Facilitates saving conversations as .txt files.
11. **Automatic Translation**: Leverages Google API for translating single messages or entire chats.
12. **Extensive Prompt Formatting Options**: Provides tools for crafting diverse and complex prompts.
13. **Character Hot-Swap Button**: Allows quick switching between favorite characters.
14. **Token Breakdown View**: Offers insights into the token usage per message.
15. **Swipe Functionality**: Enhances navigation and interaction within the app.
16. **Group Chat**: Supports multi-bot rooms for interactive and dynamic conversations among characters and users.
17. **Chat Bookmarks/Branches**: Enables saving and managing different conversation paths or scenarios.

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#extensions)扩展
structure.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#extensions)扩展

SillyTavern 支持扩展/插件：

- 角色情感表达

- 聊天记录的自动摘要

- 将图像发送到聊天室，并由 AI 解释内容。

- 稳定的扩散图像生成（5 个与聊天相关的预设加上“自由模式”）

- AI 响应消息的文本转语音（通过 ElevenLabs、Silero 或操作系统的系统 TTS）

可以使用 [SillyTavern Extras](https://github.com/SillyTavern/SillyTavern-extras) 添加其他功能。

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#installation-requirements)安装要求
structure.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/#installation-requirements)安装要求

- SillyTavern 几乎可以在任何能够运行 NodeJS v18 的设备上运行。

- 注意：由于上述要求，**SillyTavern 将无法在 Windows 7 上运行。**
